title: File private thoughts into the existing reasoning record

costar.objective: Capture that full text in the existing reasoning record.
costar.style: One function in the existing copier.
costar.audience: The next coding agent and the maintainer.
costar.response: afterAgentThought lands as kind thought, and preCompact lands as kind compaction.

concerns: Earlier thoughts were never spooled, so they cannot be backfilled.
duration_ms stays on the session event. The reasoning row holds the full text.
The secret redactor still replaces bearer-like tokens inside a thought.
context: reasoning.jsonl already accepts kind thought and kind compaction. The hook for afterAgentThought did not fill it.
current_state: spool_and_file wrote events.jsonl and copied prompts and public replies. Private thinking stayed inside the event payload only.
target_design: The same hook writes the untrimmed thinking text to reasoning.jsonl. Compaction writes every non-envelope field as kind compaction.
changes: copy_chats.py files afterAgentThought text as kind thought and preCompact as kind compaction.
The chats skill names those two writes.
The self-test checks a 4000-character thought survives and a secret inside it is redacted.
boundaries: Do not add a new store.
